text_block_list.text:
After praying at the shrine with Super 
Creek—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: ...*sigh*
choice_data_list: It's rare to hear you sigh.
It's rare to hear you sigh, huh?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I'm sorry. I'm just not feeling quite 
up to par today...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Still, the air is clean here, and it's so 
calm and relaxing.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, about our prayers 
earlier...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Trainer, did you make a wish or something?
choice_data_list: Probably just stuff about Creek, I guess.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"My, about me...? Whatever kind of favor 
could it be?"

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
If there's anything I can do, please don't 
hesitate to let me know.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ah... could it be something that's hard to 
say to my face...?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Trying to guess it might be fun 
too~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Ah, understood!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: You want to be held, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh, was I mistaken?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu, just kidding.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
There's only one thing on your mind, 
right, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
It's all right. I'm sure our future 
training will go smoothly too.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I won't let your hard work go to waste, 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I'll do my best too, so that I can bring a 
smile to your face, Trainer♪

Super Creek gives a slightly mischievous 
smile. It looks like she's back to her 
usual self.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hrmmm, nothing comes to mind...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Even though Trainer-san cares so much 
about me...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
To think that I couldn't read Trainer's 
thoughts at all...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I feel somewhat lonely...

Super Creek is feeling down. It seems she 
wasn't able to get back to her usual 
self...
